# Reference: default rules

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_reference_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every rule the framework ships with — 45 in all. Each turns recorded facts into a risk flag carrying the authority behind it.

None of these are mandatory. Every `derive_flags()` call takes a `rules=` argument, so you can reorder them, drop the ones that do not apply to your organization, or replace the set outright. See [Customising](customising.md).

**Authority** is the force behind the finding, not its severity. A `Binding Contract` finding at MEDIUM is a contract question that needs confirming; a `Technical Standard` finding at HIGH is a serious shortfall against a voluntary standard. They route differently and they are cleared by different people.

## Capability rules

`capability.DEFAULT_CAPABILITY_RULES` — 4 rules. Fire per **region** of a capability profile. A profile with three regions evaluates every rule three times, so one frame can raise a finding about its performer and nothing about its background.

| Rule | Raises | Authority | What trips it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PERFORMER_IN_GENERATED_CONTENT` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Performer collective bargaining agreement* | Performer present in materially changed or synthesized media |
| `RECORDED_PERFORMANCE_ALTERED` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Performer collective bargaining agreement* | Recorded performance altered without synthesis |
| `SYNTHESIS_IN_DELIVERED_FRAME` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Regulatory Guidance<br>*Copyright registration guidance* | Synthesized media in the delivered work |
| `THIN_HUMAN_DIRECTION` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Emerging<br>*No settled definition* | New content produced under weak human direction |

## Intake rules

`intake.DEFAULT_INTAKE_RULES` — 8 rules. Fire once per use case profile, and key on *combinations* of intake facts. Several also read the capability classification, so pass it when you have one.

| Rule | Raises | Authority | What trips it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RESTRICTED_INPUT_TO_PUBLIC_OUTPUT` | HIGH — Security / Model Integrity | Unspecified | Restricted material feeding public-facing output |
| `PERSONAL_DATA_IN_INPUTS` | HIGH — Security / Model Integrity | Statute<br>*Data protection law* | Personal data entering the workflow |
| `PERFORMER_LIKENESS_INPUT` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Performer collective bargaining agreement* | Performer likeness supplied as input |
| `LICENSED_MUSIC_INTO_NEW_MEDIA` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Content licence terms* | Licensed music feeding generated output |
| `COMMERCIAL_RELEASE_OF_GENERATED_MEDIA` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Unspecified | Generated media in a commercial release |
| `FINE_TUNING_ON_RESTRICTED_MATERIAL` | CRITICAL — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Content licence terms* | Fine-tuning proposed over restricted material |
| `BRAND_DEPICTED_ALTERED` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Unspecified | Brand depicted altered or damaged |
| `UNPROVEN_USE_IN_PUBLIC_WORK` | MEDIUM — Technical Feasibility | Unspecified | Research-stage capability proposed for public-facing work |

## Operational rules

`operations.DEFAULT_OPERATIONAL_RULES` — 6 rules. Fire once per operational profile. Most pair an operational fact with the sensitivity of the material; those stay silent when you do not pass `ip_class`, rather than assuming the worst.

| Rule | Raises | Authority | What trips it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RESTRICTED_MATERIAL_IN_VENDOR_ENVIRONMENT` | HIGH — Security / Model Integrity | Unspecified | Restricted material processed in a vendor environment |
| `RESTRICTED_MATERIAL_HELD_BY_VENDOR` | HIGH — Security / Model Integrity | Unspecified | Vendor is custodian of restricted material |
| `MANDATORY_COLLECTION_OF_RESTRICTED_MATERIAL` | CRITICAL — Security / Model Integrity | Unspecified | Collection of restricted material cannot be declined |
| `INDEFINITE_RETENTION` | MEDIUM — Security / Model Integrity | Unspecified | No stated end to retention |
| `VENDOR_CONTROLLED_UPDATES` | MEDIUM — Technical Feasibility | Unspecified | Deployed version can change without customer action |
| `REFINEMENT_IN_VENDOR_ENVIRONMENT` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Content licence and vendor terms* | Model refinement over customer material in a vendor environment |

## Sourcing rules

`sourcing.DEFAULT_SOURCING_RULES` — 12 rules. Fire once per sourcing profile, covering how a tool and its models are supplied.

| Rule | Raises | Authority | What trips it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TRAINING_SOURCES_UNDOCUMENTED` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Unspecified | Training data sources not documented |
| `WEB_CRAWL_TRAINING_DATA` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*Text and data mining reservation* | Training corpus includes web crawl |
| `DISTILLED_FROM_ANOTHER_MODEL` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Upstream model licence* | Model distilled from another model |
| `SYNTHETIC_TRAINING_DATA` | MEDIUM — Output Quality | Unspecified | Training corpus includes generated material |
| `DERIVED_MODEL_LICENCE_CHAIN` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Upstream model licence* | Model derived from an upstream model |
| `NO_SOURCE_COMMITMENT` | MEDIUM — Technical Feasibility | Unspecified | No commitment to current training-data arrangements |
| `CAPABILITIES_NOT_SEPARABLE` | MEDIUM — Technical Feasibility | Unspecified | Capabilities cannot be governed independently |
| `IMPLEMENTATION_UNLICENSED` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*Copyright law* | Implementing code carries no licence |
| `COPYLEFT_IMPLEMENTATION_LICENCE` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Software licence terms* | Implementing code is under a copyleft licence |
| `COPYLEFT_CODE_REDISTRIBUTED` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Software licence terms* | Copyleft code leaves the organization |
| `RESTRICTED_USE_IMPLEMENTATION` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Software licence terms* | Implementing code restricts how it may be used |
| `UNRESTRICTED_BYO_MODELS` | MEDIUM — Security / Model Integrity | Unspecified | Arbitrary customer-supplied models accepted |

## Vendor rules

`vendor_scorecard.DEFAULT_VENDOR_RULES` — 8 rules. Fire once per scorecard. The copyright rules stay silent unless a `CopyrightAssessment` is attached — an absent assessment is not the same as a clean one.

| Rule | Raises | Authority | What trips it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VENDOR_PENDING_LITIGATION` | CRITICAL — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*Copyright law* | Vendor has pending copyright litigation |
| `TRAINING_DATA_NOT_LAWFULLY_OBTAINED` | CRITICAL — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*Copyright law* | Training data not confirmed as lawfully obtained |
| `COMPETES_WITH_TRAINING_SOURCES` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*Copyright law* | Tool competes with the sources of its training data |
| `LICENSE_VERIFICATION_UNDOCUMENTED` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Unspecified | Licence verification not documented |
| `NO_OPT_OUT_PROCESS` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*EU DSM Directive* | No rights-holder opt-out process |
| `NO_TRAINING_DATA_SUMMARY` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*EU AI Act* | No published training data summary |
| `NO_OUTPUT_INDEMNIFICATION` | MEDIUM — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Vendor agreement* | No indemnification for claims arising from outputs |
| `UNSATISFACTORY_SECURITY_RESPONSES` | HIGH — Security / Model Integrity | Unspecified | Security questions answered unsatisfactorily |

## Provenance rules

`provenance.DEFAULT_PROVENANCE_RULES` — 7 rules. Fire once per provenance card. The two synthetic-content rules require a `ModelCollapseGuard`; without one they stay silent.

| Rule | Raises | Authority | What trips it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NON_COMPLIANT_LICENCE` | CRITICAL — Legal / IP Ownership | Binding Contract<br>*Source licence terms* | Source with a licence known to be non-compliant |
| `UNKNOWN_LICENCE_STATUS` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Unspecified | Source with unknown licence status |
| `OPT_OUT_NOT_HONOURED` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Statute<br>*Text and data mining reservation* | Rights-holder reservation not honoured |
| `NO_SOURCES_DOCUMENTED` | HIGH — Legal / IP Ownership | Unspecified | No sources documented at all |
| `UNKNOWN_GENERATION_ORIGIN` | MEDIUM — Output Quality | Unspecified | Content origin unknown |
| `SYNTHETIC_SHARE_OVER_CAP` | HIGH — Output Quality | Unspecified | Synthetic content over the configured cap |
| `NO_SYNTHETIC_DISCLOSURE_HIGH_STAKES` | HIGH — Output Quality | Unspecified | No synthetic-content disclosure in a high-stakes domain |
